name: Musician’s Grace (Combat)
body:
You can dance and flourish while smashing your enemies on the head with a lute or a flute.

Prerequisites: Proficiency in a musical instrument weapon or Catch Off-Guard and Equipment Trick (instrument), Weapon Finesse, bardic performance or raging song class feature, Perform 5 ranks.

Benefit: When using a musical instrument as an improvised weapon or a normal weapon, you can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier on melee attack and damage rolls. A light or one-handed instrument weapon is treated as a light or one-handed piercing weapon for all feats and class abilities that require such a weapon (such as a duelist’s precise strike ability). The instrument must be fit for a creature of your size.
